Product Designer - UK (Remote)

Immersive is hiring! Could you be our next Product Designer?
We’re looking for an experienced, customer-centric and data-driven individual to join our Product team as a Product Designer

As an advocate for Product Design excellence within Immersive, you will be a driver of the evolution of our flagship Immersive One platform, ensuring we continue to delight our users and expand our market leadership.

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you’ll own product problems from early discovery and definition through to validation, detailed design, delivery and iteration. You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering, using research, data and strong product judgement to shape experiences that work for customers and the wider platform.

This is a role for someone who thinks beyond individual screens — considering end-to-end journeys, information architecture, workflows, reusable patterns and how decisions scale across a complex B2B product.

You will be key in shaping the future of our products, designing flexible, intelligent frameworks rooted in object-oriented thinking and guided by customer and user feedback and research.  Your product output will drive measurable business outcomes that shape the evolution of our design system to define how cyber resilience comes to life across the Immersive One platform.

Our most successful product designers here bring a potent mix of strategic vision, user empathy, and analytical rigor to their work, while constantly expanding their knowledge through cross-team collaboration. You are the sparring partner for the Product Managers and Engineering teams with a close eye for scalability and commerciality - a true consultant who brings both research and evidence to the table and is able to articulate the ‘Why’ to validate design decisions through experimentation, metrics, and real-world usage.



As an individual contributor in the team, your main responsibilities will include:

 - Take ownership of delivering specific product features end-to-end within a quarter, ensuring your output adheres to our high standards and supports the team’s quarterly goals.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering to explore solutions, challenge assumptions and make evidence-led product decisions.

 - Transform complex, technical cybersecurity data into clear, intuitive user interfaces by utilizing human-centered design methods such as success scenarios, information architecture, user journeys, wireframes, and prototypes.

 - Formulate clear hypotheses to solve customer and business needs, and confidently validate your design decisions using both quantitative and qualitative research results.

 - Use customer research, behavioral data and product metrics to inform and validate your work.

 - Design across journeys, information architecture, workflows and reusable patterns rather than isolated features

 - Use AI-assisted design and prototyping tools where they help accelerate exploration, testing and delivery.

 - Ship feature updates at the end of the quarter that directly influence team KPIs, always considering how your design decisions impact areas outside your immediate focus.

 - Create wireframes, prototypes and detailed UI using Figma, contributing to and evolving our shared design system.

 - Contributing to knowledge sharing and the continued growth of our Product Design practice.

Sounds good? We’d love to hear from you if you have proven experience in the following areas, but don’t worry if you don’t hit each one exactly:

 - Solid experience in product or UX design, particularly within SaaS enterprise, data-rich products, and platform environments. Experience working in a Cybersecurity company would also be very advantageous but not essential.

 - Experience owning work from problem definition through to shipped outcomes. A deep understanding of human-computer interaction, allowing you to mature your design approach from basic "problem solving" to strategic "outcome delivery."

 - Confidence using research and data to make and explain design decisions.

 - Proficiency in Figma, paired with excellent storytelling skills to concisely frame your work—clearly stating the target audience, the desired outcomes, your design reasoning, and any technical or business constraints.

 - Curiousity about new ways of working, including AI-enabled design and prototyping.

 - A proven ability to collaborate closely with product managers and engineering partners, as well as external customers..

 - Strong interest in Object-Oriented UX (OOUX), alongside experience grounding your design choices in foundational human motivations.

 - A strong growth mindset demonstrated by setting personal goals, consistently giving and receiving constructive feedback, and outlining your own growth potential.

 - Strong visual and interaction design craft, balanced with a focus on customer and business outcomes.

Build and scale a best in class platform alongside a team of the brightest minds in cybersecurity! At Immersive, we’re uniquely positioned to future-proof organizations against any cyber challenge. If that excites you, read on!


 Immersive is the cyber proving ground for the AI enterprise. Trusted by 30%+ of the Fortune 100 and ranked #1 in the Forrester Wave™ 2026, Immersive helps organizations prove AI can be adopted safely, teams can develop and defend at AI speed, leaders can lead through crisis, and AI agents can be validated before they are trusted in live workflows

https://www.immersivelabs.com/why-immersive-labs

We help the world’s biggest brands like Citi, Pfizer, Humana, and HSBC, protect their revenues and brand reputations.

Immersive was founded in 2017, from a cargo container in Bristol, UK we’ve grown to over 300 employees globally, announced funding of more than $180 million and been voted a Best place to work on multiple occasions!

https://www.immersivelabs.com/company/our-story

“The speed at which Immersive produces technical content is hugely impressive, and this turnaround has helped get our teams ahead of the curve, giving them hands-on experience with serious vulnerabilities, in a secure environment, as soon as they emerge.”

Head of Global Cybersecurity Operations, HSBC




SENIOR PRODUCT MARKETING MANAGER - US (EAST COAST

We're reimagining what it means for organisations to be resilient to cyber-attacks. As Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll play a part in building out Cyber Workforce & AI Resilience as a category — owning a balanced mix of core product marketing and sales enablement across our solution areas. 

Reporting to the Director of Product Marketing, you'll shape positioning and messaging, and just as importantly, make sure that messaging actually lands with the people in the room with prospects: our sales team.



Right now, our biggest opportunity is ramp: getting reps fluent and confident on our messaging faster, so they're telling a consistent, compelling story from day one. That's where you'll start.

You'll thrive on translating complex, technical product capability into stories that are simple, sharp, and sales-ready — and you'll be just as comfortable running a training session as you are writing a positioning doc.



Your main responsibilities (we're scaling fast, so these may change as we grow):

 - Own messaging training and ramp programs that get sales fluent and confident fast — including onboarding fundamentals, live training sessions, and ongoing certification as messaging evolves

 - Develop positioning and messaging across multiple solution areas, grounded in customer, market, and competitive insight

 - Build sales-ready collateral — battlecards, one-pagers, pitch decks, and objection-handling guides — that reps actually pick up and use

 - Partner closely with Product Management to deeply understand roadmap and competitive differentiation, and translate it into consumable, jargon-free content

 - Support product launches end-to-end, ensuring sales is trained and equipped before day one

 - Gather direct feedback from sales on what's landing and what isn't, and use it to continuously sharpen training and content

 - Track adoption and effectiveness of enablement programs, and report back on what's working



You should apply if you have (we know it's tough, but please try to avoid the confidence gap — you don't have to match every requirement exactly to be considered):

 - 5-8 years of experience in product marketing, sales enablement, or a closely related field, ideally in B2B SaaS

 - Proven experience building and delivering training or ramp programs for sales teams, not just producing content for them

 - A track record of translating technical product capability into messaging that's straightforward and jargon-free

 - Comfort working autonomously across multiple solution areas at once, with the ability to prioritise as things shift

 - Strong cross-functional instincts — you'll work closely with Product, Sales, Sales Engineering, and Marketing, in both the UK & US

 - Sharp writing and presentation skills; you can make complex things simple and engaging

 - A nice to have but not essential: understanding of cybersecurity, application security, or enterprise risk, and experience with enablement platforms (e.g. Highspot, Seismic, Showpad)



This role is fully remote, open to candidates based in the UK or US.



Immersive’s growth has been fuelled by our values that underpin everything we do, here's how they relate to this role:

 - Driven - We push the boundaries of innovation, acting swiftly to achieve ambitious outcomes. Our drive embodies a culture of ambition, where challenges are stepping stones to excellence.

 - Inclusive - Our strength lies in diversity, fostering a culture where every individual contributes to our collective strength. We champion open dialogue and empathy, ensuring a collaborative, inclusive workplace.

 - Customer Centric - We seek to develop deep relationships with our customers to help them achieve their business outcomes. We exceed our customers and partners' expectations by crafting products, services and experiences that surprise, delight and ensure they feel valued and supported every day.

 - One Team - We are a talented global team working together to achieve our vision. Central to our ethos, resilience means adapting and thriving in adversity. It guides our innovation, ensuring we and our clients are prepared for the future.

We encourage people of all different backgrounds and identities to apply. We are committed to maintaining an inclusive, supportive place for you to be you and do your very best work. Excited by the above? We’re ready to receive your application!


As well as an inclusive, supportive place for you to be you. We offer an extensive range of benefits so you can do your very best work:

 - Prosper in our success with share options, and rewards for doing great work and living our values

 - Look after you and your family with health, dental, and disability insurance, fully paid sick leave, and mental health support

 - Save for the future with a 401K match of up to 5% – effective immediately

 - 33 holiday days plus two volunteering days, 12 weeks enhanced parental leave & your birthday off.

 - Flexible and remote working, so you can work when and where you work best

 - Career and learning development through the platform and our Learn Anything fund

 - While most of the team are fully remote, when you do visit, our North American HQ is based in the center of Boston, just a 10 minute walk from Back Bay train station

 - Monthly socials and sports clubs for our sociable, tight-knit teams (we’ve done everything from cake making to escape rooms)

Immersive’s commitment to fair and equitable compensation practices means that our compensation & benefits team prices each individual role before it is opened. Each team member is eligible for a compensation plan made up of a base salary + bonus (either annual or variable commission, depending on role) + equity. We expect most candidates for this position to fall within a base salary range of $135,000 - 160,000, though the specific package will vary based on a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, location and experience.


Cyber threats wait for no one and neither should you. Apply now!

Senior Solutions Architect - Saudi Arabia
We’re looking for an experienced cybersecurity professional with a number of years experience across the entire customer lifecycle - from pre-sales to post-sales and professional services - to join our growing Customer Success team as a Senior Solutions Architect based in Saudi Arabia, covering the METNA region. 

In this role, you will be the consistent value champion for Immersive from pre-sale to list sale. You will partner with our Enterprise Sales team as you conduct POVs with new & existing customers to secure the technical win, build relationships with key customers to drive business outcomes. You will be the key contact within our strategic accounts, driving platform adoption to the latest features to maximize the value of the Immersive One Platform, and executing a programmatic approach to Cyber Workforce Resilience.


Unlike traditional consultancy, which would be transactional, such as working on a single project to completion and then leaving, in this role you are embedded and dedicated to the customer for the duration of the contract. This is a long-term and continuous engagement to provide industry and operational experience to help simplify the drive for cyber resilience by aligning and complementing an organisation's cyber strategy and vision. The customer is your number one priority, and your focus is to ensure success every step of the way to ensure they are Cyber Resilient and become more mature in this space. You need to adapt to the situations you encounter and be that trusted partner to help by utilising the Immersive One platform to its maximum. Their success is your success. It feels personal.


You will be a trusted, long-term embedded consultant with knowledge in all areas of cyber. The customer will look to you for the answers, and you must be agile with on-the-spot thinking. You will interact with all customer areas, from the C-Suite to the teams and individuals that comprise the customer's organisation. You will help everyone.

As a senior individual contributor in the team, your main responsibilities will include:

 - Identify and help define prospective customers’ technical requirements / use-cases to align Immersive Lab’s technical and business value proposition 

 - Engage C-level executives, technical cyber security professionals, and major lines of business through delivering in-depth solution demonstrations and managing proof-of-concepts 

 - Act as a security advisor throughout the technical sales cycle by building cyber skills programs, facilitating crisis simulations, and measuring organizational risk

 - Partner with key customers to understand and help achieve their business, objectives, cybersecurity initiatives, and desired outcomes

 - Establish strategies and roadmaps to drive cyber workforce resilience through a programmatic approach

 - Engage C-level executives, technical cyber security professionals, and major lines of business through delivering routine Executive Business Reviews

 - Leverage your cybersecurity knowledge to recommend appropriate improvements to current programs and suggest new programs.

 - Drive adoption to maximize the value of the Immersive Labs Platform

 - Immerse into cyber security community to remain informed of evolving threats, trends, and new technologies

 - Collaborate with product, content, and engineering teams to serve as the voice of the customer and influence product innovation

Program Management

 - Support customers in operationalizing and incorporating Immersive One into their cybersecurity programs sustainably, leveraging platform metrics, custom reports and insights to bring attention to the value created along the journey.

 - Function as an escalation point and primary liaison between sales, product leadership and client accounts, including being the first sales team resource in answering questions related to service delivery within your accounts.

 - With the Customer Success Manager (CSM), assist in delivering Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) to customers, providing executive-level reports and insights that help drive long-term account health and expansion opportunities.

Sounds good? We’d love to hear from you if you have proven experience in the following areas, but don’t worry if you don’t hit each one exactly:

 - 5+ years work experience in an information security practitioner or solution consulting role as well as time spent working in a pre-sales capacity.Experience within Customer Success would be highly desirable 

 - Extensive experience in client facing roles - you will have consulted and presented to both C-level execs and technical stakeholders

 - Proficiency in IT fundamentals (computer hardware/software, databases, networking, security, and software development)

 - Authoritative knowledge of information security concepts, domains, compliances, and standards. You are an engaging speaker and presenting, able to articulate value and discuss technical concepts in a jargon free manner

 - Hands-on experience with Windows & Linux operating systems, security tools (IDS, firewalls, anti-malware, SIEM), public cloud environments, etc

 - Experience leading technical presentations for both technical and non-technical audiences across all levels

 - Industry qualifications such as CISSP would be desirable but not essential to this role

 - Career and learning development through the platform and our ‘Learn Anything’ fund

Solutions Consultant - Portugal
We’re looking for an experienced cybersecurity professional with a number of years experience across the entire customer lifecycle - from pre-sales to post-sales and professional services - to join our growing Customer Experience team as a Solutions Consultant based in Portugal -  covering the METNA, Europe & APAC regions. 

The Scale Team at Immersive is a high-velocity engine that serves a large volume of customers and prospects through a fast, repeatable, digitally-led motion. As a Solution Consultant on the Scale Team, you'll own technical pre-sales and the first two months of onboarding across many accounts, and deliver one-to-many enablement that gets customers to value quickly and supports their migration to the Immersive One Core platform.

This is a role for someone who's energised by breadth, pace, and impact at scale — who'd rather run a sharp, repeatable motion across many customers than immerse deeply in a single account. You'll work as part of the Scale Team alongside our Inside Sales Reps and Customer Operations, turning qualified opportunities into demos, trials, onboardings, and adoption — fast!




WHAT YOU'LL DO




PRE-SALES DEMOS AND TRIALS

 - Deliver product demonstrations built on the qualification Sales has completed, tailored quickly to the prospect's use case

 - Rank solution fit (Green / Yellow / Red / NA) to steer where Sales invests their time

 - Set up and run in-platform free trials, with one or two coaching sessions to guide prospects through the key features — proving value live, without bespoke success plans or post-POV reports

 - Answer technical questions and flag obvious blockers early

 - Maintain strong working knowledge of the Immersive platform and competitor technologies


ONBOARD NEW CUSTOMERS (FIRST 60 DAYS)

 - Run kick-off sessions and deliver a contained onboarding within a strict two-month window across a small number of meetings

 - Provide light-touch integration guidance — point customers to documentation and standard connectors, and route deeper technical needs to Support

 - Run month-one and month-two check-in and coaching sessions, with the digital academy as the core enablement engine


DRIVE ADOPTION AND MIGRATION AT SCALE

 - Deliver one-to-many activities — webinars, workshops, and Cyber Digital Bootcamps — to drive adoption and value across the customer base

 - Support the phased migration of Standard customers to Immersive One Core, contributing to repeatable enablement content and self-serve resources

 - Re-engage on expansion when a signal appears, running the same light demo / trial-coaching motion for the expansion scope


ACROSS EVERYTHING

 - Partner closely with Inside Sales Reps and Customer Operations to keep the motion efficient

 - Serve as the voice of the customer to our product, content, and engineering teams to influence innovation

 - Stay informed of evolving threats, AI, trends, and new technologies




SOUNDS GOOD? WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU HAVE PROVEN EXPERIENCE IN THE FOLLOWING AREAS, BUT DON’T WORRY IF YOU DON’T HIT EACH ONE EXACTLY, ALTHOUGH EXPERIENCE WORKING WITHIN CYBERSECURITY IS ESSENTIAL:

 - 2+ years in sales engineering, solutions consulting, technical onboarding, or a technical customer-facing role — ideally in a SaaS or cybersecurity environment

 - Comfortable working at high volume and pace, running repeatable motions across many accounts and keeping engagements within tight time boxes

 - You're a confident presenter to both technical and non-technical audiences, including one-to-many formats such as webinars and bootcamps

 - Able to qualify and prioritise quickly, and to communicate technical concepts in a clear, jargon-free way

 - Proficiency in IT fundamentals (computer hardware/software, databases, networking, security, and software development)

 - Knowledge of information security concepts, domains, compliance, and standards

 - Experience delivering onboarding, enablement, or one-to-many sessions at scale

 - Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) or digitally-led customer motions

 - Hands-on experience with Windows & Linux operating systems, security tools (IDS, firewalls, anti-malware, SIEM), and public cloud environments would be useful but not essential
